symptom: Both controlled and normal M07 workflows successfully invoke real Unity ValidateCompilerInputs, mutate M07Bootstrap.unity and AssemblyShadowSettings.asset, then fail because verify-installed-runtime.py requires the intentionally mutated scene to equal its pinned Git blob.
directIssue: Invoke-M07Build.ps1 performs Assert-M07ControlledPinnedInputs after validation, and Invoke-M07Build.Core.ps1 performs Assert-M07PinnedInputs at line 181 after validation. Both call the full installed-runtime verifier.
rootCause: The post-validation source guard does not distinguish immutable compiler/runtime inputs from the three workflow-owned files that ValidateCompilerInputs is designed to mutate and the outer wrapper snapshots/restores.
designGap: The new controlled path has no integration regression proving the explicit controlled throw is reachable after the intended Unity mutations, and the normal workflow retains the same incompatible post-validation guard.
impact: baseline resources and native ON/OFF Players not built
V05 successor and independent M08 unavailable
recommendedDirection: Primary should make post-validation authority checks bind immutable pinned inputs while authenticating the expected workflow-owned mutations against the captured originals and validation outputs. Preserve the outer exact-byte restore contract and add an integration test that reaches the explicit controlled throw and a normal end-to-end M07 workflow.
localAction: No local source or policy change; preserved both raw failures and exact restoration receipts.
